facts_of_case: Petitioner No. 1 and petitioner No. 2 were married on 20.01.2014. Due to matrimonial discord, Petitioner No. 1 filed a petition under the J&K Protection of Women from Domestic Violence Act, 2010. FIR No. 30/2017 was registered against the petitioners, which culminated into a final report.

legal_principles.principle: The burden lies on the party seeking to quash a petition to demonstrate that all issues have been amicably settled.
legal_principles.held: Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the disputes and differences have been amicably settled between the parties and memo of compromise also executed thereof, as such, prays for disposal of the instant petition and consequently, quashment of

legal_principles.principle: A compromise deed executed by the parties can be a valid basis for quashing a petition.
legal_principles.held: Compromise deed has also been filed.

outcome.final_order: The proceedings were put to an end and the charge sheet No. 45/2017 dated 26.12.2017 was quashed.
